name: The Cute Girl Next Door Wants to Chain Me Up and Keep Me Prisoner?!!
source:
Returning to her hometown after dropping out of university in her final year, Asher is at a pretty low point in her life- her whole family is ashamed of her failure and her former college friends have no time for her at all. Everything just feels like it isn't going right- that is, until she reconnects with her cheerful and energetic childhood friend Ellie, a sweet and fun-loving girl who seems like just about the only person in the world who is happy to see her. 

But... it's been a really, really long time since Asher's been home. A really long time. And she's about to find out that Ellie has changed in ways she couldn't possibly have imagined.
